_doc: Loop timing for the atrium walkers (#605, bake_layer.py --base agricultural), seconds; period >= the pass, the rest is a gap. The bridge walk is a 19.6 s pass (~15 s in shot), the lobby walk 30.1 s. Mismatched periods keep the two from repeating together; the offset staggers their entrances. The window traffic's timing is traffic_layers.json.
